This is the first time I have ever acknowledged my problem aside from inside my own mind. I never would have told a soul if not for the anonymous nature of v/confessions. It's just too personal, embarrassing, and I don't want the people in my life to change how they view me.

I started throwing up two years into my marriage. The stress from university, hateful in-laws, distance from my parents, my first child, hating my post-cesarean body, my husband losing his job, bankruptcy, moving to a new state, and the death of a close family member all hit me around that time.

I don't remember what first put the idea into my head, but I felt immediate relief the first time I purged. I have resorted to this in times of stress ever since. It's barely even a conscious choice. More like an urge.

This has been going on for 12 years now. The most surprising thing for me is that no one has noticed. My mother is always around, and I share a house with 4 other people, yet no one suspects a thing.

Even the warning that Bulimia can damage tooth enamel hasn't panned out. My dentist always gives me praise on the health of my teeth. Not that I am complaining. I don't want nasty teeth.

Perhaps I am just that careful? I only purge after eating ice cream, which perhaps counters the acidity of stomach acid. I also rinse well with water immediately afterwards.

I don't purge to lose weight. I maintain a healthy BMI, so no one can call me out on that either.

Still, even though I really don't want my family to know about this, it hurts a bit that even my husband has not got a single clue. I don't even go to great lengths to hide it anymore. He's so oblivious to anything except work, that I wonder if he'd notice if I threw up right in front of him. He would just assume it was food poisoning anyway, so there's no point.

Thanks for letting me get this off my chest.
